## 席位核对

Seat `domain:skills#2` · `session_01VqGhCg9wdsBXPz54uAEWg7` (os-elon-musk) · read 2026-10-15T12:48Z · head `4428e1746ad86d37069ae7b3dd838de4bc8cadd5` · **verdict: ACCEPT** (Tier S — lands on the seat only after an at-tier contract review PASS on this head)

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-23607-test-repo-ci-heavy-cloud`
Reviewed-by: `session_01VqGhCg9wdsBXPz54uAEWg7`

1. **Shape.** Draft PR against `main`; body first line `Fixes #23607`, then `Clause-②: no` at line start, copied from claim 6191711722. The only closing keyword is that one; #23606, #23660 and #23668 are named with no verb beside them. Files are `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` (+2), `references/execution-duties.md` (+3) and `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` (+21/−1, the `execution-duties.md` `CEILINGS` row and its comment block only), exactly the claimed surface.
2. **Ruling against the diff (`Ruling-ref: 6184828752`, F1 A · F2 A), read by the seat.**
   - **F1:** the new `os-dev.md` pair, directly after item ②'s continuation lines, excludes a package's `test:repo` from item ② as CI's run. A dev runs it locally only when the diff edits that project's tests or the derived list names it; otherwise `deviations` says so, and the seat's ACCEPT reads its CI. Every clause of item 1 is present.
   - **F2:** three lines sit directly under the unchanged `mode:cloud` line:
     - the surface test (`packages/spec/src/**` plus at least one other package ⇒ build-heavy, `mode:cloud`, one container per card);
     - at most one build-heavy subagent per container, and the turbo remote cache for the closure;
     - the first such dispatch measures and records its fixed cost.
     Every clause of item 2 is present.
   - Item 3 holds (no `os-verify-lock.sh` or environment change).
3. **The dev's one wording deviation, verified by the seat on `origin/main`.** The F1 line says `Test Core` runs `test:repo` on both PR and merge group, where the ruling's parenthetical says the merge group. `.github/workflows/ci.yml` L965 (`pnpm turbo run test test:repo …`) sits in the `test:` job named `Test Core` (L408, L494). Its `if:` (L501) carries no event exclusion, and the workflow triggers on `pull_request` (L33) and `merge_group` (L40), so the job runs on both, subject to its core/crosspkg path filter. The wording is accurate; accepted.
4. **Ratchet.**
   - `execution-duties.md` row 185 → 188 by the measured +3. The tightest one-line spelling measures 245 B, and neither two-line split fits the 120 B cap (137 B, 141 B).
   - `os-dev.md` +2 sits within its standing headroom of 2, so its row stays at 402.
   - The PR body quotes ruling 6184828752, authorization 6184799323 letter B item 1, and the delta. The comment block follows the #23660 convention.
   - The branch merged `origin/main` twice, the second time taking #23668's header change, cleanly.
5. **Gates and out of scope.**
   - Check-runs pinned to head `4428e1746a`: 41 check-runs, 28 `success`, 11 `skipped`, 2 `in_progress` (`Test Core (1/6)`, `Lint · CI, release & engine gates`).
   - The dev's local union covers 39 derived families, all exit 0, `--ran` 0 unrun.
   - Out-of-scope findings: none filed. The dev's Acceptance note is `dropped — not a card` (agent-text consistency, outside the three filing classes): `os-dev.md`'s report JSON template carries no `deviations` key, while the new F1 line and two earlier lines name one. Carrier: this seat's shift brief, principle class.
6. **Landing.**
   - **At-tier contract review: OWED.** The faces are `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` and `references/execution-duties.md`, at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`. That tier refused this session twice this shift (HTTP 429, the latest reported by 2026-10-15T12:41Z). The build ran at `TIER_DEFAULT` under the quota exemption, so the at-tier review is the compensating control and is not waived.
   - `needs:contract-review` stays until a PASS on this head. Then the pre-landing checks run (all check-runs green, `check-governed-merges --pr 23676` Tier S), then `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `4428e1746ad86d37069ae7b3dd838de4bc8cadd5`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/agents/os-dev.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md + scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs, .github/workflows/ci.yml, turbo.json, packages/spec/package.json, scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md

Inputs read: card #23607 body and all seven comments (director delta 6184678084, triage entry 6184799686, ruling of record 6184828752 with letters F1 A · F2 A on the maintainer's 「同意」, claim 6191711722, dispatch order 6191765315, os-dev-report 6192397780, ACCEPT 6192451825); PR #23676 body, its three-file list and the net diff against main (+26 / −1); the 47 check-runs on this head, 0 non-green (every run is success or skipped: Test Core and all six shards success, the eight Lint lanes success, every Type Check lane success, Governed Surface Queue Guard success, Check Changeset success). Isolated reviewer; the dispatching seat's conclusions were not an input. Nothing was built, run or re-run locally.

### ① Derived judgments

1. F1 text, os-dev.md L138 and L139 (+2, 101 B and 119 B) — right. It carries ruling item 1 whole: a package's `test:repo` is excluded from item ②, it is CI's run, a dev runs it locally only when the diff edits that project's tests or the derived list names it, otherwise `deviations` says so, and the seat's ACCEPT reads the PR's CI. Items ①–③ are byte-identical; the two lines sit after ②'s continuation lines and before ③. The gloss "vitest `repo` 项目" is right: `test:repo` is `vitest run --project repo` in six packages (packages/spec/package.json L303 runs gen:migration-registry first).
2. The F1 refinement 「PR 与 merge group 都跑」 against the ruling's parenthetical "on the merge group" — right, and measured here rather than taken from the PR: ci.yml `on:` lists pull_request (L33) and merge_group (L40); the Test Core shard job's `if:` (L501) carries no event exclusion, unlike the four full-battery jobs at L1648, L1987, L2214 and L2867 that exclude both events; L965 runs `pnpm turbo run test test:repo $FILTERS`; turbo.json declares per-package `@objectstack/...#test:repo` tasks with their own inputs, so a touched package's run on a PR is a real run and not a cache hit; and this head's own check-runs show Test Core (1/6) to (6/6) success on the pull_request event. The refinement is what makes the ruling's own clause "the seat's ACCEPT reads the PR's CI for that project" true, so it tightens the ruling and does not depart from it.
3. The branch 「派生清单点名它时」 — right as the ruling's wording, verbatim from item 1; empty today: scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs carries no `test:repo` literal and derives `pnpm --filter PKG run check:...` gate commands only. Harmless and future-proof; no change asked.
4. F2 text, execution-duties.md L145 to L147 (+3, 112 B, 95 B, 79 B) — right. It carries ruling item 2's four parts: the test (a declared file surface writing `packages/spec/src/**` and at least one other package is build-heavy and goes `mode:cloud`, one card per container), the per-container limit (at most one build-heavy subagent at a time), the turbo remote cache pull for the closure, and the first such dispatch measuring its fixed cost (install plus cache pull) and recording it on its card. It sits directly after the `mode:cloud` line, which is L144 on main (the ruling's `:142`, moved by the two lines #23660 inserted above it). Leaving 「build 重的 M 卡逐卡判」 in place is right: the ruled test is a sufficient condition (the card asked 「命中就走云卡」) and the residual stays a per-card call. Sibling text read for contradiction: SKILL.md L61 (`cloud` 只留 L/XL 等保留面) accommodates the new reserved face through 「等」; dispatch-runbook.md 〈云卡四课〉 and landing-operations.md L79 are unaffected; AGENTS.md names neither `test:repo` nor the cloud routing, so nothing that outranks these files conflicts.
5. The ratchet row and the raise form — right. execution-duties.md is 188 lines on the head and its CEILINGS row moves 185 → 188, exactly the measured delta; it is the only row that moves in the diff (the reviewer's completeness check the ratchet header leaves to this record). os-dev.md is 402 lines against ceiling 402, so its row correctly does not move. Three lines are needed: the landed content is 286 B against a 240 B two-line ceiling at the 120-byte cap, so no two-line split fits; the dev's tightest-spelling figures (245 B one line; 137 B and 141 B for the two splits) are consistent with that. All five added lines are at or under 120 bytes. The PR body quotes ruling 6184828752 (letters F1 A · F2 A) and authorization 6184799323 letter B item 1 together with the measured delta, which is the form the ratchet header (L66 to L77 on the head, landed by #23668) names; the comment block above the row follows the 183 → 185 precedent block's shape (ORDINARY raise, not a cross-file move, ruling id, maintainer 「同意」 verbatim, measured bytes, the authorization, not a CROSS_FILE_MOVES destination, landed count headroom 0). One reading for the record: that header says the quote is "checked by the seat's contract-review record and by the queue guard's reader"; check-governed-queue-guard.mjs on origin/main carries no ratchet, delta or ceiling reader, so this record is the check that reads the quote. It is read, and it holds. That sentence is #23668's text, not this PR's.
6. Ruling item 3 respected: scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh and the environment are untouched, the diff being three files. Item 4 is another seat's interim duty and is correctly not done here.
7. Public surface — none, so no accept-set changes. The diff is agent text under `.claude/**`, one ceiling integer and a comment under `scripts/pm/**`; no `packages/**` file, no Zod or JSON schema, no export, no runtime string. The `model: opus` in the os-dev.md hunk header is pre-existing frontmatter context on main, not a change.
8. Governance and attribution: Tier S by file list (`.claude/**`); head repo equals base repo, so not a fork proposal; the PR is draft with auto-merge unarmed and `needs:contract-review` on it; no seat has posted an approving review. The authoring commit carries AGENTS.md's model-free trailer pair (Claude-Session plus Co-authored-by: Claude); no model identifier appears in the commits, the PR title or body, the diff or the comments.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` is right and `Clause-②: no` is right (PR body line 2, at line start, no arm). The diff publishes nothing: `.claude/**` and `scripts/pm/**` belong to no released package, and no package manifest, exports map, Zod schema or generated JSON schema moves. Check Changeset is success on this head.

### ③ Boundary flags

The dev's report carries five `deviations`, an empty `open_questions`, and one `out_of_scope_findings` entry. Each answered:

- D1, the PR-versus-merge-group refinement — answered in ①.2: measured and correct; adopted.
- D2, `test:repo` not run locally — correct: no package is touched, no `repo`-project test is edited, the derived list names none; the F1 rule applied to itself, and Test Core is green on this head.
- D3, origin/main merged twice — fine: the net diff against main is three files, +26 / −1, mergeable clean; the second merge is what brought in #23668's raise form that the PR body follows.
- D4, the harness attribution reminder versus AGENTS.md's trailer pair — the dev chose right: AGENTS.md L461 to L463 is the rule of record (model-free pair; the pre-push hook refuses a model identifier in it), and the commit carries exactly that pair.
- D5, built at TIER_DEFAULT under the claim's quota exemption — this record is the compensating control the claim and the ACCEPT named; it is rendered at CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER, which closes the flag.
- Out-of-scope finding: os-dev.md's report JSON template (L361 to L377) has no `deviations` key while L60, L307, the new L139, execution-duties.md L128 and every dispatch order name a `deviations` field. Judged a note, not a card: the gap predates this PR (L60 and L307 are on main), it is agent-read text with no runtime face, and the template's own rule at L382 (「报告模板是工具,不是真相」) already licenses the field; so under Prime Directive #10 the acceptance note is the right carrier. Not blocking. Adding the key is a later edit inside os-dev.md's ratchet if the seat wants it.
- No `open_questions` were raised and nothing needs escalation.
